messages:
natalie: @here Quick announcement — rolling out the new SLO tiering policy and running a constrained canary loadtest next Tue 2027-05-17 02:00-04:00 PT. This is a planned, low-risk drill but will exercise routing and throttling for lower-tier customers.

sam: +1. Can you paste the high-level blast plan? want to confirm client backoff behaviour is covered.

natalie: Plan (short):
1) 02:00 start. Stepwise traffic shift from 0% -> 5% -> 10% -> 20% (5m hold each) to the new tiered routing policy in west and eu regions.
2) 02:30 run synthetic load: /v1/generate @ 50rps per region for 30m hitting both hosted and dedicated fronts (dedicated in canary mode only).
3) Observe p95/p99 latency, error rate, and token cost delta. Rollback if p99 > 750ms or error rate > 1.5% sustained > 2m.

Configuration snippet:
```
LOADTEST_TARGETS=(west eu)
RPS=50
DURATION=30m
TRAFFIC_STEPS=(5 10 20)
```

matt: Oncall note — i'll be watching router metrics and the autoscaler. i'll queue a temporary SLO relaxation for free tier for the 02:00-04:00 window (p95 -> 300ms).

jess: Product asks for a deploy freeze 2h before and during the test. Can engineering ops enforce deploy-lock from 00:00-04:30?

natalie: Yes — please hold user-facing deploys 00:00-04:30. Infra infra-team: please pause canary rollouts automatically.

ops-oncall: Added ticket ops-4567 with hooks for automated rollback. I'll also enable more verbose tracing for the canary traffic.

sam: Two quick Qs: 1) Will Dedicated customers on reserved pools see throttles? 2) Any manual steps to uplift KV cache warmers?

natalie: 1) Dedicated customers will not be throttled, but their canary front will be included in telemetry (we won't shift customer production traffic). We'll simulate dedicated workload on canary pools only. 2) We'll run prefix warmers 30m before start: script `scripts/warm_prefixes.sh --prefixes small-models`

eng-sre-bot: Incident guardrails check: all runbooks linked, primary oncall pinged, PagerDuty entries created for severity > P1.

matt: I'll post a short post-test summary in #eng-sre with key numbers (p95/p99, error %, token cost delta, rollouts).

jess: Thanks — i'll update the customer-impact doc and coordinate comms with support if anything spikes.

natalie: TL;DR: SLO-tiering policy goes live in canary, small-step traffic shift, synthetic load 50rps x 30m, rollback criteria listed. No user deploys 00:00-04:30. Ping me if you need access to the canary dashboards. :thumbsup:
